claim.text: voltage mean is 5.0V AND voltage stdev is 9.0V (the stdev part is false)

note: The honest-gap case this growth exists to prove: one part of the AND genuinely holds (mean=5.0) and one genuinely doesn't (real stdev is ~0.0158, not 9.0). 'A and B' is false if B is false, so this must resolve CONTRADICTED, not CONFIRMED and not a vague 'partially supported' — this adapter enforces that AND logic itself rather than leaving it to engine.py's generic trust-weighted sum.
